question: When a Florida public university or state college describes its K–12 teacher preparation, what does it say about places other than district schools?
scope: All 12 State University System universities and all 28 Florida College System colleges, as listed by the Board of Governors and the Florida Department of Education.
limit: Public web pages, catalogs and handbooks only. No syllabi, no records requests, no interviews. A line on a web page is a policy statement, not a count of where students actually trained. Charter schools, Florida Virtual School and university lab schools are public schools under Florida law. "None found" means we searched and found no setting language, not that the institution has none.
statute: Every program here operates under the same law, s. 1004.04, Florida Statutes, and the same State Board rules.

private.label: Names private schools as a place to train

public.label: Names other public options only: FLVS, lab or charter schools

jobs.label: Names private or charter schools only as where graduates or students work

district.label: Names only districts or public school settings

evidence_states.live: Quote read on the live page on the checked date
evidence_states.prior: Quote read on the live page in an earlier WMFC round, on the checked date
evidence_states.pending: Quote seen in a search index; not yet read on the live page
evidence_states.searched: Searched on the searched date; no setting language found

institutions.name: Florida State University
institutions.quote: As a charter school affiliated with Florida State University (FSU),

institutions.note: Para-to-teacher tuition support includes paraprofessionals in charter and private schools. Its elementary program cites Lake and Sumter district partnerships.
